probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source __positioned to direct visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe, wherein said light source is attached to said handpiece__.

2. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1, further comprising a power supply __mounted to said handpiece or to a cable extending from said handpiece__ and operatively connected to said light source.

3. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2 wherein said power supply includes a coil disposed about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator.

4. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 3 wherein said power supply further includes a slow-drain capacitor for providing energy or power to said light source for a predetermined period of time after termination of power conduction through said cable.

5. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2, further comprising a fastener __selected from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band__ for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece.

6. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 5, further comprising at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said power supply __to said handpiece or to the cable extending from said handpiece__.

7. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2 wherein said power supply is __a battery removably attached to said handpiece__.

8. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source includes __a light-emitting diode (LED)__.

9. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber extending from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece __for directing light along said probe__.

10. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a distal end of said handpiece and is __positioned to provide illumination along said probe to the surgical site__.

11. (Currently amended) An accessory for a surgical instrument comprising a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece, and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener __selected from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band__ for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source.

12. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil __that is disposable about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, and wherein said accessory further comprises an additional fastener for removably attaching said coil about the power cable__.

13. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 12 wherein said power supply component further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil and connectable to said light source for providing illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.

14. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes __a removable battery__.

15. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said light source includes a __light-emitting diode (LED)__.

16. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber and at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said optical fiber to said handpiece so that said optical fiber extends from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece __for directing light along the probe__.

17. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a distal end of said handpiece and for __positioning said light source to provide illumination along said probe to a surgical site__.

18. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is taken from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band.

19. (Currently amended) A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directed __along said probe__; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.

20. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19 further comprising removably mounting said power supply __to said handpiece or to a cable extending from said handpiece__.

21. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil, the removable mounting of said power supply __to said handpiece or to the cable extending from said handpiece__ including disposing said coil about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator.

22. (Previously presented) The surgical method defined in claim 21 wherein said power supply further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil, further comprising operating said capacitor to provide illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.

23. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19, further comprising __detaching said fastener and said light source from said handpiece after completion of an operation on said surgical site__.

24. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19 wherein the applying of said fastener includes positioning said light source at a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising attaching an optical fiber to said handpiece so that said fiber extends from said light source at said proximal end of said handpiece to a distal end of said handpiece __for directing light along the probe__.

25. (Currently amended) An accessory for a medical instrument comprising a handpiece and a probe or tool extension on a distal end of said handpiece, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said instrument; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, said power supply component including a coil __that is disposable about a power cable extending to said handpiece, and wherein said accessory further comprises an additional fastener for removably attaching said coil about the power cable__.

26. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 25 wherein said power supply component further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil and connectable to said light source for providing illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.
